feature_notes.spatial_coordinates: row/col/x/y intentionally excluded from Mahalanobis context vector

covariance_definition: Empirical sample covariance (ddof=1) over actual crp_cell_assignments records in feature_order; zero matrix when n_k=1.
regularized_covariance_definition: covariance + epsilon*I, retained as a runtime-safe optional matrix for inversion; canonical covariance remains empirical.
quality_score_definition: Geometric mean of categorical_compactness, quantitative_separation, and sample_support; bounded to [0,1].

quality_components_definition.categorical_compactness: Mean fraction of STATE_COLUMNS matching the cluster canonical medoid signature.
quality_components_definition.quantitative_separation: nearest_centroid_distance/(nearest_centroid_distance + 2*within_cluster_rms_radius) in globally standardized runtime feature space.
